# Daily Report — 2026-08-24

## Task Completed
Added `export_assessment_responses` tool for retrieving per-question response
detail from the `asmt_assessment_instance_question` table.

Highlights:
- New `ExportAssessmentResponsesParams` model with four bounding filters
  (`instance_id`, `metric_type`, `metric`, `user`) plus `has_comments` and
  pagination controls. At least one bounding filter is required so the query
  cannot return the entire table.
- New `_format_assessment_response` helper normalises the ten most useful
  fields (instance, metric, metric_type, user, string_value, value,
  comments, created/updated timestamps) to display values.
- New `_resolve_metric_sys_id` helper resolves an individual question by
  sys_id or exact name via `asmt_metric`; falls back to a `metric.nameLIKE`
  filter if a name lookup returns nothing.
- Metric-type and user filters reuse the existing `_resolve_metric_type_sys_id`
  and `_resolve_user_sys_id` helpers.
- `has_comments=true` appends `commentsISNOTEMPTY` to restrict results to
  responses with free-text feedback.
- `limit` capped at 1000, standard `has_more`/`next_offset` pagination.
- Registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and both
  `system_administrator` and `full` packages in `tool_packages.yaml`.

## Test Results
- Total tests: 3175
- Coverage: 95%
- All passing: yes
- `assessment_tools.py` coverage: 96% (406 statements)
- 30 new tests covering:
  - `_format_assessment_response` (reference normalisation + missing fields)
  - `_resolve_metric_sys_id` (sys_id passthrough, name lookup, not-found,
    HTTP error)
  - `ExportAssessmentResponsesParams` (defaults + all-fields)
  - Guard paths: no filter provided, no `instance_url`, no headers, metric
    type not found, HTTP error
  - Happy paths: filter by instance_id, metric_type name, metric sys_id,
    metric name fallback, user sys_id, user name fallback, `has_comments`
    filter
  - Pagination: limit cap at 1000, `has_more=true` when page is full,
    `has_more=false` when page is partial
